stage32_roadmap.close_criterion: complete orbit list of every numerical Picard class satisfying the audited necessary conditions; effectivity intentionally not credited

logic.target_object: actual integral irreducible unibranch low-genus carrier C in the Stage32 32-01 scope
logic.terminal_map: any such C appearing in the compressed authority population determines its matching terminal pairings
logic.pruning_conclusion: For a numerical search whose semantics are all classes satisfying audited necessary conditions for target carriers, the contrapositive is sufficient to remove rejected terminals while preserving every target carrier.
logic.reverse_realization_not_needed: It is not necessary to prove that each rejected terminal has an integral Picard completion, an effective divisor, or an integral irreducible representative in order to reject it as a possible target carrier.
logic.reverse_realization_role: A/B/C reverse realization is relevant to positive existence/effectivity claims or R29-LG2-EFF, not to a one-way necessary-condition pruning of R29-LG2.
